svg.title: Assessment-first (Option C): the chain from the rule to the claim and the result
svg.desc: A chain of 6 steps, each drawn as one row per relationship, with the field that holds the pointer on the left and the field it resolves to on the right. Step 1, rule to check, is made of 2 relationships. no field in the assessment-plan containment to activities[].steps[].uuid in the assessment-plan. steps[].props[name=check].value in the assessment-plan, which holds SV-270747r1066730_rule, name match to no field in the nothing. Step 2, rule to control, is made of 1 relationship. activities[].related-controls.control-selections[].include-controls[].control-id in the assessment-plan, which holds sc-28, reference to controls[].id in the catalog. Step 3, check to runtime, is made of 1 relationship. assessment-platforms[].uses-components[].component-uuid in the assessment-plan, which holds 56270516-2673-4d4c-8d4f-52e4107f968d, reference to assessment-assets.components[].uuid in the assessment-plan. Step 4, runtime to claim, is made of 1 relationship. import-ssp.href in the assessment-plan, which holds #d381c885-4851-4931-828c-29bbb24fbaa3, reference to back-matter.resources[].uuid in the assessment-plan. Step 5, runtime to result, is made of 1 relationship. observations[].subjects[].subject-uuid in the assessment-results, which holds 61b3ec99-dfbe-4997-8a66-6f2279edb84b, reference to activities[].uuid in the assessment-plan. Step 6, result to control, is made of 1 relationship. findings[].target.target-id in the assessment-results, which holds sc-28_obj, reference to controls[].parts[objective].id in the catalog. Every value is rule 1, data at rest, as the six questions page encodes it for this approach.
